summary: Round 23 security fixes tested end to end and all pass. Backend: socket_round23_reset_signout.cjs ran the full flow for a driver (sarah) and a dashboard user (dispatcher). Forgot-password, then reset with the token from the dev log, gives 200. The live socket that was open before the reset is disconnected by the server ('io server disconnect') on both '/driver' and '/'. The old access token gets 401 on /auth/me, the old refresh token gets 401 on /auth/refresh, and the old access token can no longer open a new socket. Reusing a reset token gives 400. Logging in with the old password gives 401; the new password logs in, /me, refresh and a new socket all work. Both passwords were then restored and verified. test_round23_security.py passes 20/20. Covered there: alg none, HS512/HS384 signed with the real secrets, a tampered payload, a wrong ver, and access and refresh tokens swapped are all rejected with 401. On all 4 endpoints the 11th try for the same IP+email gets 429 with Retry-After <= 900 and the 'Too many attempts. Please wait N minutes' message, and a spoofed X-Forwarded-For does not reset the counter. Email case is folded, and another account still logs in. The 51st login across emails from one IP gets 429, and driver-login is a separate bucket. A normal login under the limit works. CSV/XLSX export with driver 4 temporarily renamed to =HYPERLINK("..","x, y"): CSV shows the name as a quoted '= text cell with inner quotes doubled; XLSX has no <f> formula cells and the cell text is '=HYPERLINK...; dispatcher 200, driver 403. Name restored. Driver app (390x844): login stores accessToken/refreshToken in AsyncStorage (localStorage on web), Home shows, reload keeps the session, and logout clears all keys and stays on Login after reload. After a reset done elsewhere (background script), the app went back to Login on its own on the next background request and the keys were cleared. Dashboard: login, navigation across Drivers/Trips/Reports/Vehicles/Corrections, silent refresh after a corrupted access token, and logout clearing the tokens all work. The 429 message shows on the dashboard login form. All 7 test_credentials accounts log in at the end. Michael's trip 6 is still in_progress. auth_rate_limits cleared.

minor.issue: When an admin sets a new password here, tokenVersion is not bumped and sockets are not disconnected, so the old sessions keep working (the refresh token for up to 7 days). Only the reset flow signs out other devices. userController.ts:99-102, driverController.ts:98

Not atomic. The token is marked used only after the password is saved (authController.ts:214-245), so two requests sent at the same time with the same token can both succeed. Claim the token first with UPDATE ... SET used_at=now() WHERE id=? AND used_at IS NULL, and check the affected row count.

The 50-per-IP bucket counts successful logins too. Drivers on one depot NAT/Wi-Fi at shift start could lock everyone out of driver-login for up to 15 minutes. Consider counting only failures, or a higher per-IP limit for driver-login. The fixed window also allows a burst of 2x at the window edge (minor).
The response includes the internal tokenVersion field. Exclude it the same way passwordHash is excluded.

Cosmetic: XLSX string cells never run as formulas, but the ' prefix is written into the cell text, so it shows as a visible apostrophe in Excel. Either drop the prefix for XLSX, or use the cell quotePrefix style. CSV is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: Login errors use Alert.alert (LoginScreen.tsx:24), which does nothing on react-native-web, so wrong-password and 429 messages are not shown in the web preview. Native builds are fine.

action_items: MEDIUM: Bump tokenVersion and disconnect sockets (disconnectUserSockets / the driver room) when an admin changes a password via PUT /users/:id or PUT /drivers/:id.
LOW: Make the reset token single-use atomically (conditional UPDATE before changing the password).
LOW: Exclude tokenVersion from driver API responses.
LOW: Review the per-IP limit for driver-login (count failures only, or raise it) so drivers behind a shared depot NAT are not blocked.
LOW: XLSX export: skip the ' prefix, or set the quotePrefix style, so no apostrophe shows in the cell.
LOW: tokenStorage.read (native): wrap the SecureStore calls in try/catch. A keystore error currently throws out of AuthContext.checkAuth's catch block (line 70 calls getAccess again).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.ts/socket.ts pin algorithms to HS256 and check tokenVersion on REST, refresh and both socket namespaces.
rateLimit.ts fails open on DB errors, which is reasonable. trust proxy=1 worked in the preview: the XFF spoof did not bypass the limit.
driver-app api.ts:6 still has a hardcoded fallback production URL (pre-existing).
seed_data_creation: None. Driver 4's name was temporarily changed and then restored to 'Sarah Johnson'. The sarah, dispatcher and maria passwords went through reset and were restored to their test_credentials values; their tokenVersion was bumped. auth_rate_limits cleared at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reset tokens are stored hashed. Read them from /var/log/supervisor/fleet-test-api.out.log ('Development reset link for <email>'). The dashboard has no data-testids; use input[type=email], button[type=submit] and [title=Logout]. In the driver app, set localStorage 'privacyNoticeSeen:v1' first to skip the privacy sheet. Clear auth_rate_limits between batches.
